items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Hazel Scott got me interested in it. When I first saw it, nobody was living on there but she and Adam Clayton Powell. So she got me to come up and look at this property and I bought it

ctx.x: Uh-huh. So she says, 'Look, now, --' my daughter then was a teenager and my son next to her, he was a teenager, so she says, 'These streets in Amsterdam, on Amsterdam Avenue,' she says, 'I'm going to go out and look for a house.' I said, 'Well, go ahead.' And she went and she looked, she looked and she looked. She couldn't find anything. So we bought some property in White Plains.
